title: On (m, w)-Generalized Group Inverse in a Banach Algebra
content: By combining the sum of a weighted group inverse and a quasinilpotent element, we introduce an extension of the m-weak and generalized group inverses in a Banach *-algebra. We develop various properties and representations of this weighted generalized inverse. Furthermore, we apply this new generalized inverse to complex matrices and solve a minimization problem.
